response.answer: To structure robustness and bias analyses, use genre/section splits, closed-class vs open-class tests, domain-shift stress tests, and downstream parsing/IE metrics like UAS/LAS and extraction F1 to identify systematic errors. These methods ensure comprehensive evaluation of model performance across different contexts and data types.
